hip-12390.x: Federation pleasure planet orbiting in the Epsilon Ceti binary system, renowned for its climate-controlled tropical resorts.

jupiter.x: Giant planet converted into a miniature sun named Lucifer by self-replicating monoliths in 2010: Odyssey Two.
Gas giant whose gravitational capture threatens Earth during the acceleration flyby, overcome by igniting Jupiter’s hydrogen-oxygen mix.
Living Edenist biotechnology orbital habitat orbiting Jupiter, serving as an autonomous haven and central nexus of the Edenist culture.
Orbital anchor for the relativistic wormhole interface linking the Sol system to distant star systems across the Coalition expansion.
Destination of the nuclear tandem-mirror exploration ship Von Braun in Planetes, and the vital helium-3 harvesting domain of the Jupiter Fleet in Gundam.

gaia-4683897617110115200.x: Colony world orbiting the subgiant Beta Hydri where human Academy archaeologists study the tragic ruined cities of the vanished amphibious Quraquans.
